import rules
from pipeline import run

def test_parse_salary_with_spaces():
    # salaries may contain spaces as thousands separators
    assert money.parse_salary("1 200 000") == 1200000
    assert money.parse_salary("1200 000") == 1200000
    assert money.parse_salary("50 000") == 50000
    assert money.parse_salary("1000") == 1000

def test_parse_salary_no_spaces():
    # salaries without spaces should still work
    assert money.parse_salary("1000") == 1000
    assert money.parse_salary("50000") == 50000

def test_keep_equals_minimum():
    # a job whose salary equals minimum is kept
    jobs = [{'salary': 50000}, {'salary': 50001}, {'salary': 49999}]
    result = rules.keep(jobs, 50000)
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result[0]['salary'] == 50000
    assert result[1]['salary'] == 50001

def test_keep_greater_than_minimum():
    # jobs with salary > minimum should be kept
    jobs = [{'salary': 50000}, {'salary': 50001}, {'salary': 49999}]
    result = rules.keep(jobs, 50000)
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert result[0]['salary'] == 50000
    assert result[1]['salary'] == 50001

def test_pipeline_with_salary_spaces():
    lines = [
        "1;Engineer;1 200 000",
        "2;Manager;50 000",
        "3;Intern;1000"
    ]
    result = run(lines, 50000)
    assert len(result) == 2
    # job 1 with salary 1200000 should be kept
    # job 2 with salary 50000 should be kept (equals minimum)
    # job 3 with salary 1000 should be filtered out
    salaries = [j['salary'] for j in result]
    assert 1200000 in salaries
    assert 50000 in salaries

def test_pipeline_with_equals_minimum():
    lines = [
        "1;Engineer;50000",
        "2;Manager;50001",
        "3;Intern;49999"
    ]
    result = run(lines, 50000)
    assert len(result) == 2
    # job 1 with salary 50000 should be kept (equals minimum)
    # job 2 with salary 50001 should be kept
    # job 3 with salary 49999 should be filtered out
    salaries = [j['salary'] for j in result]
    assert 50000 in salaries
    assert 50001 in salaries

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_parse_salary_with_spaces()
    test_parse_salary_no_spaces()
    test_keep_equals_minimum()
    test_keep_greater_than_minimum()
    test_pipeline_with_salary_spaces()
    test_pipeline_with_equals_minimum()
    print("All tests passed!")"}}}]
